title: Budget-sensitive first-home couple
buyer_primary_need: Affordable first home for a couple and young child, with a manageable monthly loan commitment and a Type A 900 sq ft layout that feels usable for the family.
key_information_learned: Own-stay couple with a young child; wife is a joint decision-maker.
Budget is around RM3xxk, and the preferred loan instalment is about RM1.5k/month or less.
The buyer is unsure what a bank would approve; a roughly 30-year tenure is only tentative.
The buyer is concerned the living area may feel cramped, but finds the separate bedrooms useful.
The buyer is interested in viewing the Type A layout with his wife and checking the current package, but wants to review available slots before deciding on a time.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Hi, I saw the ad. How much is this project?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Pearlmont’s listed base price starts at RM328,000. The package reference I have lists an 8% rebate for some unit categories—around RM302,000 if applicable. The final price depends on the specific unit and current package, so those details would need confirming. All Phase 1 units are 900 sq ft with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Are you looking for your own stay or as an investment?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Own stay, me and my wife with our young child. We’re looking around RM3xxk if possible—monthly commitment is quite important for us.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Understood—monthly affordability matters, especially with a young family. The 900 sq ft, 3-bedroom, 2-bath layout may be worth assessing for your own stay. The listed base price starts at RM328,000; the earlier 8% package only applies to some unit categories and needs current confirmation, so I wouldn’t treat RM302,000 as confirmed. The maintenance fee is listed at RM0.18/sq ft, about RM162/month for 900 sq ft, separate from the loan instalment. What monthly amount would feel comfortable for you?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Ideally the loan instalment would be around RM1.5k a month or less, if possible. We’re still figuring out what the bank would approve, so don’t want to assume based on the price alone.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: That makes sense—we’ll treat RM1.5k as your comfort ceiling, not assume what the bank will approve. The instalment depends on the approved loan amount, tenure and rate; the listed maintenance fee of about RM162/month is separate. Do you have a loan tenure in mind?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Not sure yet, maybe around 30 years depending what the bank offers. Also wondering if 900 sqft will feel a bit tight for the three of us—how is the Type A layout arranged?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Type A is a 900 sq ft layout with a private entrance foyer, an open living, dining and kitchen area, three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony. The living/dining/kitchen area is about 405 sq ft; the bedrooms are about 143, 117 and 103 sq ft. Project materials describe all three bedrooms as able to fit a queen-sized bed, though how spacious it feels will depend on furniture and how you use each room. For the three of you, it offers a separate room for your child, but it’s still worth judging against your actual furniture and storage needs. A 30-year tenure can be used as an illustration, but the instalment would still depend on the approved loan amount and rate.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks, that helps. The separate bedrooms sound useful, but I’m still a bit unsure whether the living area will feel cramped for us. Could be worth seeing the Type A layout in person with my wife, and checking the current package too. What viewing times are available?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Let me check the available viewing times and confirm the current package so I can give you the right details. I’ll have the team follow up to arrange a time that works for you and your wife.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Okay, thanks. Please share a couple of available viewing slots and the confirmed package details when you have them, then I’ll check with my wife.

transcript.speaker: human
transcript.message: I can’t verify viewing slots in this simulator, so no available times are confirmed. The current package validity and the package applicable to a specific unit are also unverified; the package reference only documents rebate categories, not a confirmed current offer. Nothing is booked.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks for being upfront. Please send a couple of slots and the package details once they’re confirmed, and I’ll check with my wife before deciding on a time.
